note:
2140 -> 2108 (-32). Second pass on the typecheck lane, after both default-deny locks reached green: clearing near-zero excepted files so they can leave the exception list, plus the worst source-file budget overage.

Same root cause as the first pass, twice more: JSDoc saying `Object` -- the interface, which has no index signature and no members -- where a plain state record was meant.
  - search/search_state.js: 13 such annotations across the state serialisers (itemsToState / queryToState / panelToState and their inverses). 48 -> 7, taking it back under a budget it had drifted 19 over.
  - Two type-declaration gaps fixed at source rather than cast at the call site: `effect.add` typed its params bag as `{type?}` while forwarding every other key verbatim to the registered effect (which documents message / img_url / fadeout / Component / props), and the mock server's MenuDefinition omitted `webIcon` / `webIconData`, both of which navbar.xml reads.

One real defect found on the way: state_selection_field.test.js asserted with `"there should be a dropdown".msg` -- undefined on a string -- so that assertion had never carried its message. Also normalised 14 `confirm: "Enter"` call sites to the canonical lowercase "enter" that ConfirmAction declares (hoot lowercases at runtime, so behaviour is unchanged).

Exception lists: 574 -> 550 (noImplicitAny) and 441 -> 435 (strictNullChecks); coverage 59.7% -> 61.4% and 69.0% -> 69.5%. No ceiling was raised in either budget file.

Command: npx tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit | grep -c 'error TS'
